title: Title page of Miertsching's Reise-Tagebuch, Gnadau 1855
creator: Johann August Miertsching
description: The German title page of the journal of Johann August Miertsching, the Moravian missionary who sailed as Inuktitut interpreter aboard HMS Investigator on the North-West Passage voyage of 1850-54. His diary is the fullest account of the Investigator's people and of the Inuvialuit and Copper Inuit they met, and it was published in German before any English version existed.

title: Chart of Greenland, Davis Strait, Cumberland, Frobisher Strait, Hudson Strait and Labrador
creator: Lith. Anst. v. L. Kraatz, Berlin
description: The folding chart in Miertsching's German journal, lithographed in Berlin, showing Cape Farewell, the Davis Strait, Cumberland and Northumberland Inlet, Frobisher Strait, Hudson Strait and the Labrador coast, with the outward route marked.
